provider_api.request_media(client): Returns kinds:list[image|audio|video],prompt:str,counts:dict,encoded_bytes:int. Scans all user/assistant history for media presence, latest user prompt only, omits system instructions and ARQUIVO blocks. No data URIs or bytes returned. Parser projection is not media validation or consent.
provider_api.wire_messages(messages,prefix,profile='': MiMo user lists only; image flag required for list attachments, media flag additionally required for audio/video. Both flags derive from authenticated server consent v2, never request JSON. Unknown parts and assistant media fail closed. Existing prefix and ACOM projection preserved.
provider_api.limits(provider,*,media_authorized=False: MiMo imagens=True; audio/video=True only with explicit media_authorized; Kimi/DeepSeek media false. No automatic routing implementation included.
provider_api.metric_task(messages): Host calls iald_task_policy.classify on last user textual content excluding ARQUIVO blocks. Ignores client task labels, system/developer instructions, tool outputs and media bytes. Produces classification only, no prompt saved.
provider_api.Evaluation.stream: record.task populated by metric_task(messages) before self.save/dispatch; record.model remains exact configured transport model.
provider_api.Evaluation.observe(flow,model,*,rates=No: Optional host messages argument; task classification when supplied; unknown when absent. Coordination must pass actual host conversation, never a client-provided task label.

local_limits: One audio/video per user message; decoded512000bytes; audio30seconds/video10seconds; strict base64, MIME/signature, stream-type and measured-duration gates. Request/context byte admission remains intact, can refuse input that leaves no response budget. No truncation added.
decoder_dependency: WAV uses Python wave to measure duration without external executable. Other formats require local ffprobe through PATH, subprocess without shell, file protocol only, timeout5s, temporary directory removed. ffprobe not found in this session PATH. MP3/FLAC/OGG/M4A and video stay visibly refused until trusted decoder available. No install authorized/performed here.
client: app/iald.js staged; picker extensions controlled by audio/video flags, local metadata duration and byte bounds, preview player using local data URI, name textContent; object URL revoked after duration check; unsupported browser codec fails visibly. PDF text and images keep existing composer. Audio/video serialized into official parts. montarEnvio retains parts instead of silently flattening when capability changes. No index.html edit needed.
